Model. There are 20 tickets, each with six labels, 22 triple supports and 27
pair supports. Pair-linearity means that each ticket pair occurs in at most
one support. Thus their overlap graph G has 93 edges and g_v=6+d_v. For this
profile d=(6^2,5^8,4^2,3^2,0^6), sum d=66 and sum d^2=322. In H=complement(G),
deg_H(v)=13-d_v and |H|=97. Counting triples by their H edges gives
 T=t(G)=C(20,3)-18*97+sum C(13-d_v,2)-t(H)=290-t(H).
Independently, Goodman gives t(G)+t(H)=1140-sum (6+d_v)(13-d_v)/2=290.

Core/zero split. Let K={d>0}, |K|=14, |Z|=6, sigma_x=|N_G(x) intersect Z|,
zeta_u=|N_G(u) intersect K| and r=sum sigma=sum zeta. All triples lie in K.
Only the 6-d_x pair labels of x can reach Z, hence 0<=sigma_x<=6-d_x.
In particular the d=3 and d=4 ranges are 0..3 and 0..2, respectively; a
d=3 vertex need not have a nonpositive term in the older d>=4 proof.
A zero has degree six and only five other zeros, so 1<=zeta_u<=6.
Put M=H[K], MZ=H[Z]. Their degrees are h_x=7-d_x+sigma_x and a_u=zeta_u-1.
Consequently |M|=(32+r)/2, |MZ|=(r-6)/2, r is even and 6<=r<=18.

Exact remainder. Every mixed H triangle has one same-part H edge. Over xy
in M, its Z apices number 6-sigma_x-sigma_y+c_Z(xy), where c_Z counts common
G neighbours in Z. The corresponding count over uw in MZ is
14-zeta_u-zeta_w+c_K(uw). Therefore
 t(H)=6|M|+14|MZ|-sum sigma*h-sum zeta*a+P,
 P=t(M)+t(MZ)+sum_{xy in M} c_Z(xy)+sum_{uw in MZ} c_K(uw)>=0.
Every summand is a cardinality; no support arrangement can make P negative.
Substitution gives the exact identity
 T=F-P, F=236+sum_K sigma_x(sigma_x-d_x-4)+sum_Z zeta_u^2.

Analytic fallback. Since (zeta-1)(zeta-6)<=0 on 1..6 and the cross sums
agree, F=200+sum sigma(sigma+3-d)+sum (zeta-1)(zeta-6). The coordinate maxima
at d=6,5,4,3 are 0,0,2,9. Thus T<=200+2*2+2*9=222<265 analytically.

Stronger finite relaxation. Independently sort sigma within each equal-d
class and sort zeta; the objective, domains, balance and parity are invariant
under these permutations. Enumerate every such integer vector with the full
ranges above, equal cross sums and even r. There are 1507 and max F=218.
Every legal support realization maps to one of these vectors. We impose no
graphicality, cross-incidence, triple-decomposition or P-attainability filter:
dropping those constraints enlarges the set. Hence T=F-P<=F<=218 for the
ENTIRE profile. Relaxed equality vectors are not claimed to be realizable,
and 218 is not claimed to be the exact attainable maximum.
